description: Translation files for World Spinner internationalization (i18n). Each language has its own JSON file with matching keys.

structure.note: Translation files use a simple nested structure with a maximum of 2 levels deep
structure.interpolation: Use {variableName} for dynamic values, e.g., 'Hello {name}' or 'You discovered {country}'

categories.capytan: Tips and messages from Capytan the capybara guide
categories.buttons: All button labels throughout the application
categories.clueBoard: Clue board section headers, labels, and empty states
categories.discoveryLog: Discovery log section headers, labels, and empty states
categories.form: Form field labels and placeholder text

addingLanguages.step1: Create a new JSON file named with the ISO 639-1 language code (e.g., fr.json for French)
addingLanguages.step3: Translate all values while keeping the keys in English
addingLanguages.step4: Ensure the structure remains max 2 levels deep
addingLanguages.step5: Test that all keys match exactly with en.json
addingLanguages.step6: Submit a pull request with your new translation file

guidelines.keepKeysInEnglish: Always keep the JSON keys in English (e.g., 'buttons.spinGlobe'), only translate the values
guidelines.maintainStructure: Keep the same nesting structure as en.json
guidelines.testLocally: Run 'npm test' to verify your translation file is valid and has matching keys
guidelines.ageAppropriate: World Spinner is for kids ages 6-10, keep translations simple and friendly
guidelines.preserveEmojis: Keep emojis in button labels as they are universal visual cues
